sourceLines.locator: Portable Ladder Safety QuickCard — inspection prior to use / damaged-ladder disposition
sourceLines.excerpt: Always inspect the ladder prior to using it. If the ladder is damaged, it must be removed from service and tagged until repaired or discarded.

sourceLines.locator: Portable Ladder Safety QuickCard — three-point contact
sourceLines.excerpt: Always maintain a 3-point (two hands and a foot, or two feet and a hand) contact on the ladder when climbing.

sourceLines.locator: Portable Ladder Safety QuickCard — facing ladder / body centered
sourceLines.excerpt: Keep your body near the middle of the step and always face the ladder while climbing (see diagram).

sourceLines.locator: Portable Ladder Safety QuickCard — self-supporting ladder configuration
sourceLines.excerpt: Do not use a self-supporting ladder (e.g., step ladder) as a single ladder or in a partially closed position.
The cap (if equipped) and top step of a stepladder are not used as steps;
The area around the top and bottom of ladders shall be kept clear.
Select, and have each affected employee use, the types of PPE that will protect the affected employee from the hazards identified in the hazard assessment.
Defective or damaged personal protective equipment shall not be used.
The employer shall ensure that each affected employee uses eye protection that provides side protection when there is a hazard from flying objects.

The floor of each workroom is maintained in a clean and, to the extent feasible, in a dry condition. Walking-working surfaces are maintained free of hazards such as sharp or protruding objects, loose boards, corrosion, leaks, spills, snow, and ice.

The announcement states the standard one-year Nassau residency/continuation rule, a Farmingdale UFSD No. 22 Suffolk-resident exception limited to that district, and a special Village of Freeport residence requirement.

facts.label: Open-competitive minimum qualifications
facts.value: By the closing date, one of three routes: one year of satisfactory building-cleaning-and-maintenance experience; six months of satisfactory experience in a listed trade or other related maintenance work; or one year of satisfactory experience as Cleaner in a Nassau County school district.

facts.label: Promotion filing period
facts.value: Opened June 11, 2026. Applications for the later-added Jericho Public Library jurisdiction alone were accepted through July 5, 2026.

facts.value: 41 jurisdictions in the original ANNOUNCED FOR list.
facts.detail: Superseded when Lynbrook Union Free School District was added June 18, 2026.

facts.label: Promotion jurisdictions after first amendment
facts.value: The original 41 jurisdictions plus Lynbrook Union Free School District.
facts.detail: Superseded when Jericho Public Library was added June 26, 2026.

facts.label: Current promotion jurisdiction list
facts.value: 43 jurisdictions: the original 41 named jurisdictions, plus Lynbrook Union Free School District and Jericho Public Library; the Jericho-only application extension ran through July 5, 2026.

facts.label: Promotion minimum qualifications
facts.value: Employment in the jurisdiction in which promotion was sought; two continuous years there in the non-competitive class as Cleaner immediately before the written test; continued service through appointment; qualifying part-time employees eligible. Under the announcement's Civil Service Law §52.10(a) note, qualifying provisional time immediately preceding permanent appointment counts toward time in title.
